description: This Java source file defines the SequenceUtil class, which manages unique sequence IDs using database-backed sequence banks, including thread-safe operations and database transaction handling.

classes.name: SequenceUtil
classes.description: Utility class for managing sequences with database-backed sequence banks, supporting thread-safe ID generation and bank refresh.

classes.name: SequenceUtil.SequenceBank
classes.description: Inner class representing a sequence bank that manages a range of sequence IDs, handling database updates and concurrency.

methods.name: SequenceUtil
methods.description: Constructor initializing SequenceUtil with helper info and sequence entity details.

methods.name: getNextSeqId
methods.description: Returns the next sequence ID, possibly filling the bank if needed.

methods.name: forceBankRefresh
methods.description: Forces a refresh of the sequence bank for a given sequence name.

methods.name: getBank
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a sequence bank for a given sequence name.

methods.name: SequenceBank
methods.description: Inner class managing a range of sequence IDs, with methods to get next ID, refresh, and fill the bank.

methods.name: SequenceBank
methods.description: Constructor initializing sequence bank with sequence name and size.

methods.name: getNextSeqId
methods.description: Provides the next sequence ID, filling the bank if current range is exhausted.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the bank by updating current sequence ID and filling a new range.

methods.name: fillBank
methods.description: Fills the sequence bank by updating the database within a transaction, handling concurrency and errors.
